pages.title: Summonable Helper
pages.text: Right-click to summon a combat doll where you are looking, up to 2 blocks away. Each doll item is used up when summoned, and only a limited number can be active at once.

Every doll keeps its own health, name, dye color, and combat equipment. Its health is shown by the item's durability bar. Right-click the doll in your inventory to open its loadout. If a doll reaches zero health, it becomes broken and must be repaired in an anvil with wool before it can fight again.
